_provenance.schema_ref: No declared schema. .claude/workflows/system_orchestration/artifact_schema_specification.yaml declares tier3_source_schemas for selected_call, topic_mapping, compliance_profile, partners, milestones_seed and working_assumptions, and none for this file. _provenance.authoring_route: Authored directly as JSON. Decision D1.
_provenance.two_readers: This file has two readers that disagree on the work package key. runner/dev_graph/builder.py reads 'wp_id'; runner/dependency_normalizer.py reads 'id'. Neither is wrong and this ticket changes neither module, so every work package carries both keys with the same value. tests/test_demo_architecture_seeds.py pins them equal. Finding F1.
_provenance.field_mapping: lead_partner, responsible_partner and contributing_partners are pseudonyms of partners.json. 'objectives' names objectives.json. 'constraints' names sources.json entries, because the dev-graph predicate constrained_by runs work_package -> source. 'dependencies' names task ids and becomes a task -> task consumes edge. 'produced_by' names the tasks of the same work package.
_provenance.duration_basis: Months run M1 to M48. The duration is the operator's choice of 2026-09-30, Assumed, recorded in selected_call.json as project_duration_months and declared in working_assumptions.json.
_provenance.scope_note: Seven work packages. Tier 2A states no maximum for RIA: section_schema_registry.json carries max_work_packages null and the form asks only that the count be proportionate. Phase 3 refines this structure; it does not replace it.

cross_work_package_dependencies.why: The protocols build on the metadata profile the data management plan fixes.
The pipelines implement the integration architecture.
A campaign starts once its case is selected.
A campaign starts once the joint protocol exists.
Acquisition follows the architecture that says what to acquire.
Omics sampling follows the same joint protocol as every other layer.
Metabolomics is measured on the terrestrial plots the campaign runs.
The omics records join the rest through the metadata standard.
The training resource is documented against the joint protocol.
The models train on the observations the acquisition task produces.
The decision surface reads the architecture's outputs.
A protocol transfers only once it has been run.

content.cross_work_package_dependencies_note: Twelve edges crossing a work package boundary, each one also present in the task's own 'dependencies' array, which is authoritative. This list carries the reason, which the array has no room for, and a test holds the two in agreement. These edges are what the shadow impact planner propagates along, so the demo exercises the planner rather than a chain of independent work packages.
content.deliverable_coupling_note: Deliverables are coupled across work packages through milestones, not directly. The dev-graph relationship set has no deliverable-to-deliverable predicate: a deliverable reaches a milestone by 'validated_by' and a milestone gathers deliverables from several work packages. Seven of the eight milestones do. A deliverable that depended on another deliverable could not be expressed in the graph at all. Finding F12.

effort.reason: Person-months are not seeded. Nobody has agreed an effort split for a consortium whose every member is Assumed, and a seeded figure would read as a consortium decision. The shares the design implies are declared in working_assumptions.json under 'effort_shares'; Phase 3 and the budget route resolve them.
